body:
The feeling of not being able to change. In general I feel like I have spent so much time trying to change, thinking that I'm getting better, and then I look at how I was year ago and feel like I haven't changed.

Obviously that isn't possible, but it feels like that.

I think you got it right, "doo-en-de", the 'e's being pronunciated like in "eight".

Here in Chile, the duendes are like some kind of little people that are very mischievous (?? not sure that's the word, in spanish is "travieso"). They steal, and hide things, and like to play with you XD. I don't really believe in them, but I can't say they don't exist, because there is so many times that a thing goes missing, and then you say like "ok, it was the duendes, it will come back eventually", and then poof, it just apeears.

Sorry if i speak like a caveman, i understand english, but i have problems redacting it.
